schemaExactSet.detail: The database has 116 migrations and every readiness authority observation returned true.

dockerSocketIsolation.detail: Only sandbox-broker mounts /var/run/docker.sock. api, worker and postgres have no socket mount.

brokerCredentialIsolation.detail: The broker receives only its runtime database URL, master key and broker auth/config/public key. No DingTalk, GLM, DWS or company-MCP credential is mounted into it.

workerHeartbeat.detail: The worker writes /data/worker-heartbeat after each successful publish cycle. Docker reports healthy with a fresh file; the same predicate returns false for a two-minute-old file and for a missing file, and true for the live file.

nonRootRuntime.detail: api, worker and sandbox-broker run as uid 10001.

toolchainPin.detail: All three application containers run Node v24.21.0.

externalCalls.detail: Every probe was loopback HTTP, in-container HTTP or PostgreSQL. No DingTalk, DWS, GLM or upstream company-MCP call was made.

prodComposeRender.detail: deploy/compose/compose.prod.yml renders for the default, dingtalk, scoped, dws and sandbox profiles with placeholder variables, and still exits non-zero when a required variable is empty.

repeatableProbe.note: The curated checks in this file were produced by hand; the probe above reproduces them mechanically and writes the machine-generated report. It records mount names, environment-variable names, counts, statuses and hashes only.

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: The sandbox-broker container was running a stale image whose compiled required-migrations contract contained 114 entries, while the database had 116. Its readiness endpoint therefore returned 503 NOT_READY while the API stayed healthy.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Rebuilt anthys-sandbox-broker:dev from the current tree and recreated the container. The rebuilt image reports 116 required migrations and /health/ready returns 200 READY.
defectsFoundAndFixed.verification: image required-migrations.json = 116, last = 116_company_data_template_lifecycle.sql; container health = healthy; in-container /health/ready = 200.

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: ANTHYS_SANDBOX_SECRETS_DIR=.secrets/sandbox-broker in .env and .env.example was resolved by Compose against deploy/compose, so recreating the broker failed with a missing producer-public.pem bind source. The previous container only worked because it predated the setting.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Corrected the value to ../../.secrets/sandbox-broker in .env and .env.example and documented that the value is Compose-project-relative.
defectsFoundAndFixed.verification: docker compose --env-file .env -f deploy/compose/compose.dev.yml --profile sandbox up -d --no-deps --force-recreate sandbox-broker recreated the container successfully and it became healthy.

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: The worker had no declared healthcheck, so a wedged publish loop would still appear as a running container.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: The worker now writes /data/worker-heartbeat after each successful publish cycle, throttled to one write per 5 seconds. Dev and production Compose declare a 30-second freshness healthcheck.
defectsFoundAndFixed.verification: The rebuilt worker reports healthy with a fresh heartbeat. The same predicate exits 1 for a two-minute-old heartbeat and for a missing heartbeat, and exits 0 for the live file.

testEvidence.flakinessNote: The same two-file combination failed intermittently under load (one run with 9 failures and a later run with 1 failure) before passing twice in a row, including one run on the pre-change tree. The failing assertions are the deadline-sensitive guardian and trial-authority harness in trial-process-supervision.test.ts. The worker heartbeat path is inert in these tests because WORKER_HEARTBEAT_FILE is never set there, so the flake is not attributable to this change.
testEvidence.fullSuite: The full vitest suite (3391 tests) was last executed green at the previous commit and was not repeated in this slice. The committed reports/vitest-latest.json still holds that full-suite result and was restored after the targeted runs overwrote it with a 20-test subset.

limitations.workerHeartbeatSemantics: The worker healthcheck proves that the publish cycle keeps completing; it does not execute a queued model run and is not a substitute for live provider acceptance.
limitations.ingress: The DingTalk long-connection ingress service is opt-in and was not started; it requires a live app identity.
limitations.liveAcceptance: Live GLM, DingTalk, DWS and upstream company-MCP acceptance remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. This report proves local deployment integrity only; affected T-cases remain NOT_RUN and R items remain IN_PROGRESS.
limitations.secretHandling: No secret value is reproduced in this report. Only mount names and environment-variable names are listed.
